release_notes:
Add automatic Zelle payment gateway with instant credit

Customers can now pay with Zelle and have credits added automatically,
instead of waiting for manual approval. A new "ZellePay (Auto)" payment
method reads your Zelle notification emails, matches each payment to
the right customer by their username or invoice number in the memo,
and credits the account within minutes - no admin action needed.

On the payment page, customers just enter an amount and submit; the
QR code and payment instructions now show on the invoice screen right
after, with a clear example of what to write in the memo. If a payment
can't be matched automatically within 12 hours, you get an email so it
can still be approved by hand.

To turn this on, add the gateway under Payment Methods, enter your
Zelle inbox's Gmail app password and your bank's notification email
details, then set up the cron job shown on that page.
